name: Ibu
source:
Member of the Special Division 3 of the demon supervision unit. At a young age, he takes on the role of captain of the Special Division 3. He is mild-mannered and usually has a soft smile on his face. In the past, he used to be very stern. Acquainted with Touka.

[Translated from [url=http://lovedelivery.biz/suito/chara.html]the official website[/url].]
